title: Telfer Tree — Main Family Line
body_markdown:
# 🌲 Telfer Tree

> **The main line.** From Scottish immigrant Francis Telfer through to Mark, Kylie, and the kids. Everything else (Parker, Lawrie, Baker) feeds into this line.

```
[[Francis Telfer (1809–1895)|Francis Telfer]] (~1809–1895) ← Scottish immigrant, *Prince George* 1838
  └── + [[Margaret Wright Telfer (?–1892)|Margaret Wright]] (third wife)
        └── [[John Telfer (1847–1929)|John Telfer]] (1847–1929) + [[Caroline Amelia Telfer (1842–1929)|Caroline Amelia Masters]] (1842–1929)
              └── [[Francis Charles Telfer (1875–1954)|Francis Charles "Charlie" Telfer]] (1875–1954) + [[Amy Ellen Telfer (1884–1951)|Amy Ellen Provis]] (1884–1951)
                    └── [[Murray John Telfer (1924–2009)]] (1924–2009)   ◄── 9th of 10 kids
                          └── + [[Shirley Edna Telfer (1929–2017)|Shirley Edna Parker]] (1929–2017)
                                ├── [[Daryll William Telfer]]
                                ├── [[John Robert Telfer|John Robert Telfer]]
              │     ├── + [[Robyn Telfer]] (wife)
              │     ├── [[Angela Telfer]] (adopted)
              │     ├── [[Peter Telfer]] (adopted)
              │     └── [[Carissa Telfer (?–2023)]] (adopted, † 29 Jun 2023)
              ├── [[Grantley Keith Telfer|Grantley Keith Telfer]]
              │     ├── [[Kristin Stefanoff|Kristin Telfer]] (m. Ben Stefanoff, Nairne SA)
              │     ├── Jono Telfer
              │     └── Nick Telfer
              ├── ★ [[Timothy Neil Telfer (1959–?)]] (Dad)
              │     ├── + [[Penny Telfer]] (biological mother of his children)
              │     │     ├── [[Mark Kenneth Telfer (1986–?)|Mark Kenneth Telfer]] (b. 21 Mar 1986)
              │     │     │     └── + [[Kylie Isabella Telfer (1982–?)|Kylie Isabella Dance]] (m. 12 Mar 2016)
              │     │     │           ├── [[Mitchell Telfer (2008–?)|Mitchell Telfer]] (b. 28 May 2008 — Crystal Rose McDonald)
              │     │     │           ├── [[Levi Leonard Timothy Telfer (2017–?)|Levi Leonard Timothy Telfer]] (b. 31 Jan 2017)
              │     │     │           └── [[Zabella Violet Zelda Telfer (2019–?)|Zabella Violet Zelda Telfer]] (b. 19 Feb 2019)
              │     │     ├── [[Amy Nicole Telfer]] (Redcliffe QLD)
              │     │     └── [[David Telfer]] (half-brother, lives Rockhampton)
              │     └── + [[Sheryle Telfer (1961–?)]] (m. 28 Aug 1999) → [[Wedding - Tim & Sheryle Telfer (28 Aug 1999)|💍]]
              │           ├── + [[Paul Ivory (1955–1996)]] (1955–24 Dec 1996, aged 41, suicide — Sheryle's first husband)
              │           │     ├── [[Aaron Ivory]] (step-brother, Sheryle & Paul's son)
              │           │     ├── [[Jared Ivory]] (step-brother)
              │           │     ├── [[Lauren Ivory]] (step-sister)
              │           │     └── [[Joel Ivory]] (step-brother, lives in China)
              ├── [[Kathryn Mavis Telfer (1961–1965)]] (deceased)
              └── [[Susan Shirley Lawrie|Susan Shirley Lawrie]] (née Telfer)
```

## ⚠️ Earlier Generations — Confirmed
> **Furthest confirmed:** [[John Telfer (of Castleton)]] + [[Elspeth Young]] (James Telfer's parents, baptised James 14 Jul 1761 at Castleton OPR). Further back is unconfirmed.

```text
[[John Telfer (of Castleton)]] (~1715–1735?) + [[Elspeth Young]]
  └── [[James Telfer (1761–1845)]] + Betty Hutton (1776–1853)
        └── [[Francis Telfer (1809–1895)]] + Margaret Wright
              └── [[John Telfer (1847–1929)]] + Caroline Amelia Masters
```

> **Scottish records needed:** Castleton OPR registers (FamilySearch batch C11865-1, microfilm 1067953) contain baptisms from 1749. John Telfer (~1715–1735) would need a search of the full Castleton OPR (1697–1819) via ScotlandsPeople (£) or FamilySearch.

title: Lawrie Tree — Shirley's Maternal Line
body_markdown:
# 🌲 Lawrie Tree

> Shirley's mother's side — **Ayrshire Scots.** From Alexander Lawrie (1780, brick wall for parents) through to Caroline Edna Lawrie who married William Henry Parker.

```
[[Alexander Lawrie (1780–1847)]] (1780–1847) — born Auchtermuchty, Fife, Scotland (moved to Ayrshire after marriage) — brick wall for parents
  └── + Jean Dunlop (b. c.1791)
        └── [[John Lawrie (1810–1888)]] (1810–1888) — born Galston, Ayrshire → arrived SA
              └── + Janet/Jean Dunlop (1811–1902)
                    └── [[Robert Dunlop Lawrie (1850–1917)]] (1850–1917) — Long Plains farmer
                          └── + Caroline Hosking (1851–1920)
                                └── [[Caroline Edna Lawrie (1890–1957)]] (1890–1957)
                                      └── + [[William Henry Parker (1893–1968)]]
                                            └── [[Shirley Edna Telfer (1929–2017)]] — LINK TO TELFERS
        └── Alberta Grace "Gracie" Lawrie (b. 1882)
              └── + George Carslake
                    └── Graham Carslake (author, Lawrie family history)
```

## 🔍 Notes
- **Alexander Lawrie (c.1776) is a brick wall** — his parents are unknown
- **Caroline Hosking (1851–1920)** — born New Cumnock, Ayrshire, Scotland; parents Thomas Hosking (Cornish, from St Columb Major) & Catherine May. Family migrated Cornwall→Scotland→SA following copper mines.
- The Dunlop name appears twice (Jean Dunlop married Alexander Lawrie, Janet/Jean Dunlop married John Lawrie) — likely related but unconfirmed
- Graham Carslake wrote the Lawrie family history — living descendant who may have more records

title: Parker Tree — Shirley's Paternal Line
body_markdown:
# 🌲 Parker Tree

> Shirley's father's side — **Ayrshire Scots.** The Parkers arrived from Tarbolton, Ayrshire, Scotland in 1852 and farmed at Long Plains, SA.

```
[[David Parker (1822–1888)]] (1822–1888) — born Tarbolton, Ayrshire, Scotland; arrived SA 1852 on Martin Luther
  └── [[William Humphrey Parker (1850–1926)]] (1850–1926) — born Ragged Hill, Ayrshire; farmer at Long Plains
        └── + Hannah Baker (1855–1948) — born Peachy Belt SA to English parents (Devon & Norfolk)
              └── [[William Henry Parker (1893–1968)]] (1893–1968) — born Long Plains SA; farmer
                    └── + Caroline Edna Lawrie (1890–1957) — m. 29 Mar 1917
                          └── [[Shirley Edna Telfer (1929–2017)|Shirley Edna Parker]] (1929–2017) ← LINK TO TELFERS
                                └── + [[Murray John Telfer (1924–2009)]] (Telfer main line)
```

## 🔗 Related
- [[Family Tree]] — master overview
- [[Telfer Tree]] — main line (where Shirley connects)

- [[William Humphrey Parker (1850–1926)]] — Shirley's grandfather

- [[Hannah Parker (1855–1948)]] — bridge to Baker line

## 🔍 Notes
- The Parker family is **Scottish, not English**. The earlier "Leeds/Yorkshire" theory was incorrect — that came from confusing Parkers with the Baker/March lines.
- The Parker ↔ Baker marriage (William Humphrey Parker + Hannah Baker) is where the English Baker/March/Webster lines feed into the Scottish side.

title: Baker / March / Webster Tree — English Roots
body_markdown:
# 🌲 Baker / March / Webster Tree

> Shirley's **English** roots — the Baker (Devon), March (Norfolk), and Webster (Norfolk) families. These are the non-Scottish branches that connect into the Parker line through Hannah Baker's marriage to William Humphrey Parker.

```
[[John Webster (1750–1810)|John Webster]] (1750–1810) — North Walsham, Norfolk
  └── + Sarah Ann Dobbs
        └── [[William Webster (1778–1816)]] (1778–1816) — Tuttington → Aylsham, Norfolk
              └── + Susanna Hewett (1781–1850)
                    └── Sophia Webster (1803–1892) — m. Joseph March
                          └── [[Joseph March (1797–1883)]] (1797–1883) — born Aylsham, Norfolk; arrived SA on *Canton*, 31 Jul 1846
                                └── + Sophia Webster (1803–1892) — also born Norfolk, England
                                      └── [[Sophia Baker (1829–1901)|Sophia March]] (1829–1901) — born Aylsham, Norfolk; arrived SA 1846
                                            └── + [[William John Baker (1831–1919)]] (1831–1919) — born Bickleigh, Devon, England; parents James & Jane Baker
                                                  └── [[Hannah Parker (1855–1948)|Hannah Baker]] (1855–1948) — born Peachy Belt SA
                                                        └── + [[William Humphrey Parker (1850–1926)]] (Ayrshire line, Parker Tree)

Also: [[Joseph March (1767–1831)|Joseph March]] (abt 1767–1831) — father of Joseph March (1797), Aylsham Norfolk
  └── + Sarah Jacobs (1763–1811) — m. 24 Feb 1791, Aylsham
```

> **Note:** These are the English branches. The Parker family is **Ayrshire Scots** — not English. The earlier "Leeds/Yorkshire" theory was incorrect. English roots come via the **Baker family** (Devon) and **March/Webster families** (Norfolk).
